column1: # Census bytes that were read by a person and are data, not code: no instruction to match, so they leave the
# Phase 2 denominator (tools/census_classify.py). A byte that a route ran or a matched body covers is never
# excluded by this table. Add a range only after reading it; when in doubt leave it out, which keeps the byte
# in the denominator. Columns: module, first linear address, length in bytes, what it is and how it was checked.

column4: screen and message text with box-drawing characters, a word table of characters (0x2C2E) and C-runtime messages; read in full, 0x027AE..0x02D64
zero fill, the C runtime's messages ("Error releasing overlay memory", "_C_FILE_INFO=", "Assertion failed"), and small tables; read in full
zero fill plus the C runtime's messages, "_C_FILE_INFO=" and small tables; read in full (the census lists it as a function)
a lookup table: zero fill, then an arithmetic sequence of byte values with flag bytes 40/80/C0/00; the census rows 0x02920 and 0x029E6 overlap it; read in full, 0x02920..0x02B25
